messages:
anya: Quick UX nit from design review: the retention dropdown in compliance settings currently shows '90 days, 180 days, 1 year' but the labels don't indicate whether it's data-store or logs retention. customers are confused which retention they are editing. :confused:

mike: Good catch. We have two distinct retention fields under the hood: `data_retention_days` and `audit_logs_retention_days`. The UI conflated them under one 'Retention period' heading. :grimacing:

elaine: Accessibility / copy note: use explicit label text like 'Data retention (records)' and 'Audit log retention (events)'. Also add helper text: 'Applies to stored inference data and embeddings' vs 'Applies to console and API audit events'.

anya: UX idea: use a 2-column layout for desktop so both retention controls sit side-by-side and scale down to stacked on mobile. Add a small info icon next to each with accessible tooltip content.

mike: backend has a single settings API v2 that accepts both fields. No blockers. we should still confirm default values for tenants upgrading: current default for audit logs is 365 days, data store defaults to 90. We'll surface the defaults in the UI.

copybot: suggested helper copy:
- Data retention (records) — "How long user data, embeddings, and model outputs are stored. Default: 90 days."
- Audit log retention (events) — "How long audit events (login, admin changes, API calls) are kept. Default: 365 days."

elaine: tiny accessibility nit: the info icon needs aria-label and the tooltip should be reachable by keyboard and read by a screen reader; use role="tooltip" and aria-expanded on the trigger. Also ensure color contrast for the helper text meets AA.

anya: mobile behavior: collapse into a single 'Retention' accordion with a summary line like 'Data: 90d • Audit logs: 365d' — that makes it compact. When expanded show the two controls plus the helper text.

mike: logging/telemetry request: add an event when a tenant changes retention fields: `ui.settings.retention.update` with payload {field, old, new}. We'll add to the settings service.

tz-qa-bot: CI note: we have a flaky test around settings save. it times out when network is slow. recommend adding retry on the e2e for the settings save step.

elaine: also add inline validation for unreasonable values (<1 day or >3650 days) with an error message: 'Please enter a value between 1 and 3650 days.' Ensure the error is announced for screen readers.
